# Markdown Parser Notes
This project turns *small* Markdown documents into HTML.
Use `cargo test` often.
Visit [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/).

## Groceries
- Apples
- Oranges
- <Bread>

## Steps
1. Read the input
2. Parse **blocks**
3. Render HTML

> Keep the scope small
> Learn one concept at a time

```
# Not a heading
- Not a list item
let value = 1 < 2;
```
